audit.whatIsWrong: Both chart layers read Cassiopeia/Cassiopeia/Cassiopeia/Skill/Cassiopeia/Skill/Cassiopeia while the packet levelChart reads Olaf/Skill/Cassiopeia/Skill/Skill/Skill/Skill — and the packet order matches the whys[] row for row. The difficulty framing is wrong too: 8.5/10 'Hard matchup' with a red tone against an Emerald+ win rate of 56.1% over 656 games.
audit.why: whys[0] 'you are top-tier — Undertow slow into a passive-fueled auto wins first contact' is an Olaf row marked Cassiopeia; whys[1] 'genuinely even', whys[4] 'read-dependent' and whys[6] 'it stays skill' are Skill rows marked Cassiopeia. A 56.1% win rate is not an 8.5/10 lane.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Olaf, Skill, Cassiopeia, Skill, Skill, Skill, Skill in BOTH layers as one atomic group; diffRating, tone, breakdown.difficulty and report[14] brought to 6/10.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was framed as Cassiopeia's on a chart row the packet calls Skill, and the ult's value was overstated as answering 'her whole kit'.
audit.why: Ragnarok (100/90/80s) is armour and MR plus immunity to disables while attacking. That covers Petrifying Gaze's stun (120/100/80s), which only lands on enemies facing her — the back-turned half is a slow and is NOT covered. Miasma's slow is not covered either. So 6 is a genuine read, not a free dive, exactly as whys[4] says.
audit.corrected: phases[4], spikes[1] and whys[4] now split the ult's coverage: stun yes, slows no.

audit.whatIsWrong: The single most important interaction in this matchup is absent: Miasma's grounding does essentially nothing to Olaf, because Olaf has no dash or movement ability in his kit. The page instead builds five fields around 'her W grounding cancels your gap-close' — Olaf's gap-close is walking, which grounding does not stop.
audit.why: Riot text, Cassiopeia W: 'slowing, grounding, and lightly damaging enemies... Grounded enemies cannot use Movement abilities.' Olaf's four abilities are a thrown axe, an attack-speed shield, a melee true-damage strike and a resist/immunity toggle — no movement ability among them. The thing that actually stops him is the SLOW, and that is what the advice should key on.
audit.corrected: Stated in tldr, winCon, report[0], report[1], spikes[1], mid, phases[2], wants.you[1] and wants.foe[1], with the slow named as the real threat.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'W-omnivamp' in spikes[2], mid and wants.you[2]. Olaf's W is Tough It Out — attack speed plus a shield, 16/15/14/13/12s, no healing.
audit.why: Riot text, Olaf W: 'Olaf's Attack Speed is increased and he gains a Shield.' The lifesteal is Berserker Rage (P), scaling with missing health.
audit.corrected: Named as the shield in all three.

edits.before: Levels 3-5 she gets her grounding online — respect that her W (Miasma) cancels your gap-close, so chain Undertow slows to close the gap on foot instead of relying on one dash. Bait the W before you all-in. At 6 Ragnarok is the answer to her whole kit: it cleanses and grants immunity to her R face-stun and lets you charge through the slow zone, so flash-ult or just R-walk her down and Reckless Swing for the guaranteed true-damage chunk while W-omnivamp heals her poison ticks off.
edits.after: Levels 3-5 Miasma comes online — but grounding only shuts off movement abilities and Olaf has none, so what actually hurts you is its slow. Chain Undertow slows to close on foot and bait the 24s W before you all-in. At 6 Ragnarok answers half her kit: it is immune to Petrifying Gaze's stun, though not to her slows, so R-walk her down and Reckless Swing for the guaranteed true-damage chunk while Tough It Out shields the poison ticks.

notes: Petrifying Gaze only stuns enemies FACING Cassiopeia and slows those with their back turned — nothing on the page mentions the facing condition, and it is the difference between eating a stun and eating a slow while you walk out. There was no writable field with room to add it inside the length band without cutting something more useful, so it is recorded here. Olaf's Undertow (Q) carries a derived 'grounding' flag that Riot's description does not support (armour shred and slow only); no grounding claim was made for it.
